title: Gaussian main term below boundary
statement: For all sufficiently large integers $q$, half of $m_q\sqrt{2\log(1/m_q)}$ is strictly less than $b_q$, where $m_q=1/(q+2)$ is the prescribed Gaussian mass and $b_q$ is its Gaussian isoperimetric boundary value.
